title: Decisions view asks for the reason when choosing an option
description: Choose this fails silently: the server needs --why and the view has no field for it. Add a reason field and show server errors.

outcome.summary: Choose this asks for a reason in the decision view; the server message shows under the options. Choosing no longer re-renders over the error.
outcome.verifiedBy: Browser check on a throwaway project: empty reason shows the message; with a reason the decision is decided and the reason is stored; node --test 109 pass.
